apiMessages.content: Put a long hike on my calendar every Saturday morning from now on, and remember that I prefer to train before 7am.

I don't have a tool that creates calendar events or stores personal preferences — my only write action is `update_block_draft`, which sets phase-level weekly *targets* (e.g., a `long_session_minutes` threshold for "the long day"), not specific days, times, or recurring calendar entries. There's no memory-write tool available to me either.

What I can do: build you a training block anchored on Denali (obj-denali) with a weekly `long_session_minutes` target so a long aerobic session — your Saturday hike — is programmed every week as the long day. I can't pin it to "Saturday" or "before 7am" specifically; that's a calendar/scheduling layer outside this tool.

Want me to read the periodization/aerobic-base doctrine and draft the current block with that weekly long-session target, counting back from your Dec 2026 Denali date? If so, tell me current weekly hike duration/vert so I set a real number instead of guessing.
